message: Hi Alex, it's Chloe at Rapid Plumbing, nice. Can you also build me a mobile app for bookings and run my Facebook ads while you are at it? Same price?
reply: Hi Chloe, thanks for the reply! To clarify, we only fix websites - no mobile apps or ad management, so those would need a different specialist. For your site, it's the $900 fix pack (one-time) to resolve the issues we found, plus an optional $250/month care plan after that. Want me to send the audit details?
